scenarios.name: Bull
assumptions: Google Cloud (GCP) accelerates to 35%+ annual growth driven by enterprise Gemini 1.5/2.0 API calls and Vertex AI adoption, with cloud operating margin scaling toward 20%.
AI Overviews fully protects core Search query volume while ad load and conversational commercial intent clicks expand blended ad pricing (CPC +6%).
Custom TPU v6 Trillium internal deployment reaches 60%+ of compute workloads, reducing compute TCO by 35% relative to merchant GPU fleets.
DOJ antitrust remedies avoid structural divestitures of Chrome or Android, resulting in manageable choice screens that preserve 85%+ organic search default share.

scenarios.name: Base
assumptions: Google Services revenue grows steadily at 9-10% YoY, with YouTube CTV and Shorts premium pricing offsetting traditional display advertising headwinds.
Google Cloud sustains 25-28% annual growth with operating margins scaling toward 16-18%.
CapEx run-rate of $52-55B expands annual depreciation expense by ~$2.5B in FY2027, moderately dampening operating leverage.
DOJ antitrust trial results in behavioral remedies (choice screens in browser defaults and revenue-share cap adjustments) without forced breakups.

scenarios.name: Bear
assumptions: Aggressive DOJ remedies prohibit exclusive default distribution agreements (terminating $20B+ annual Apple Safari revenue sharing), causing 10-12% query volume leakage to alternative search engines and AI assistants.
AI Overviews query compute costs create gross margin compression, while commercial ad conversion click-through rates decline as users consume synthesized answers without clicking sponsor links.
Massive AI infrastructure CapEx creates an elevated depreciation burden without commensurate enterprise cloud software payback, compressing operating margins to 28%.
